stem:
Meena's father buys a new battery for the torch used at their home in Jaipur. The shopkeeper tells them that this battery can be connected to a charger again and again, so it can be used for many months instead of being thrown away after it is used up once.
Which statement correctly classifies this battery?

options.text: It is a single-use cell because all batteries stop working after some time.
It is a rechargeable cell because it can be recharged and reused many times.
It is a single-use cell because it is used inside a torch.
It is a rechargeable cell because it is sold in a shop and not made at home.

teacher.key_rationale: A battery is classified as rechargeable when it can be recharged and reused multiple times, unlike a dry (single-use) cell that must be discarded once exhausted. The described battery can be charged again and again for many months, so B is correct. Options A and C wrongly classify it as single-use, and D gives an irrelevant reason.
